tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: How the app boots: Vite serves index.html, main.ts mounts the Svelte 5 App component to #app, imports global CSS, and injects Vercel Analytics

tour.title: App Shell & State Management
tour.description: The monolithic App.svelte orchestrates all UI sections. It consumes the central Svelte store (store.ts) and shared TypeScript types (types.ts) that define BuildState and all game data structures

tour.title: Damage Calculation UI
tour.description: BaseDamageCalc.svelte and DamageAnalyzer.svelte are the core calculator views. They read build state from the store, run engine computations, and display damage breakdowns, scaling, and tooltips

tour.title: Engine Core — Build Resolution
tour.description: The engine transforms BuildState into BuildResult. build.ts orchestrates weapon/enchant/shrine computations; weapon.ts calculates weapon stats; enchant.ts enforces slot rules; dmgTypeBonuses.ts computes type bonuses from perks

tour.title: Game Data — Mechanics & Formulas
tour.description: TypeScript modules implementing game mechanics: Perkbasedmg.ts resolves perk damage definitions, BuffData.ts handles buff/debuff descriptions and potency, and statboost.ts computes stat conversion formulas

tour.title: Game Constants — Shared Values
tour.description: All numeric constants and labels are centralized in src/lib/constants/. index.ts re-exports sub-modules for damage types, perk base damage, buffs, thresholds, cooldowns, and more — the single source of truth for game tuning

tour.title: Reusable UI Library
tour.description: Primitive UI components in src/lib/ui/ (Badge, Button, Card, Panel, Stat, Section) provide consistent styling across the app. Barrel index.ts re-exports them for convenient imports

tour.title: Build Persistence & Data Layer
tour.description: BuildSaves.svelte handles saving/loading builds to localStorage. Engine data modules (character.ts, equipment.ts, weapons.ts) load JSON game data (races, guilds, perks, armors, blades, etc.) and provide typed lookups
